notes.title: Chapter 8. Inheritance. Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Chapter 8 is available! 
Equip your entire team with shields, or raise a legionnaire to rank of Legate. Perhaps you want to lead an army of darkness, then give them black flag and immortality will be one step closer.

A new book has been added - Inheritance. 
It will allow you to save loot from previous adventure to dispose of it when you need it. 

Bugworks and other fixes:

 Fixed a bug with moving from Arena to camp.
 Fixed a bug where auto camp settings were not saved after an arena.
 The line *From now on you are a flag bearer!* has been changed. You can now get red, orange, yellow flags instead of just red.
 Fixed scrolling in Arena menu.
 Priests of Light are now counted for opening a Priests Guild.
 Fixed a bug where *Sing me some more* illustration was still not doubling chorus:
For ancient dagger, whom in a chest, there is apprentice found
Temper your arrogance - so says the teachings of the candle
From now on you are a flag bearer!
 Fixed a bug where lines might not work in Mad Artist mode:
Let's look in the archives
Ah, how it all began!..

 Removed delay for auto-soup.
 Fixed a bug where counting of notes, unburnable manuscripts and feathers was based on current zone instead of the maximum achieved in current adventure.
 Fixed a bug where *+2 extra marks when applying marks* line was not apply to undead strike marking.
 Clarified description of the line: For there is virtue in the shadows, too!
 Clarified description for Enhanced weapon mode.

notes.title: Big update! Two new quests, candy goat
notes.notes:
A new quest «We tell no tales» has been added.
Undead begin the journey to find legendary book Necronomicon to learn all aspects of dark magic and become perfect warriors. When search comes to an end, change of appearance or summoning of skeleton monk will be within reach of even weakest of Undead.

A new quest «Nature's roots» has been added. 
A group of Druids decided to collect all known to them druidic spells to preserve them for their descendants. Task is not an easy one. They will have to go around the world and visit all Druid villages to make sure they don't miss any of secrets of their brothers and sisters. Group heard that the Druids are capable of capturing lions and even saddling wolves. And the most skilled of nature's followers have power to control 2 mighty stumps.

Сandy goat has been added.
It allows you to accumulate candy, which is spent on a reroll. When goat is full, you can smash it and get many gifts that will help you on your current journey as well as future adventures. Сandy goat can be found at Сandy house.

Additions and changes:

 Hero information now indicates revivals from all bonuses if hero is Undead.
 Bug fix, when with book of Dragon studied, you could get 18 garnets for the first blood of the dragon, instead of 10.
 For chapter 7 marked lines that are choruses.
 The ESC button is used to close various menus and enter settings menu.
 Now with shift holding you can pump characteristics of heroes at 10 points, and with ctrl to maximum.
 Auto dwarf mode gained an additional option. Distribute jelly can now be first between favorite characters, then between others.
 Added additional option to mark your favorite heroes on battlefield.
 In cursor selection menu you can change size of cursor.
 Added screen resolution of 2560x1440.
 Improved operation of the Hanged Man.
 Fixed bug with duplicate toad when using a rune.
 Popup text is no longer climbing on top of bottom bar.
 In quest selection menu, quests are arranged in order they are opened by zone.
 Improved scrolling in quest selection menu.
 Bug fix, when chiromancy hands worked during any pause.
 New steam achievements added
